items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: recorded in Australia with master cornet player Bob Barnard. And it’s called “The Man From the South,”

ctx.x: Yeah, there’s lots. I could work more than I am. Because playing all the instruments, I get calls from more bands than like guys that just play one horn. Plus I lead two bands of my own and I’m in a big band. And it’s a good thing Bob Barnard, because Bob is the king in Australia, you know, he’s the man, he’s out of the country a lot, which is good for me. So when they can’t get Bob they ring me. And so I’m there a lot of the time. And we all do festivals in Melbourne and Adelaide, and interstate things, for…
Australia is very — there’s a lot of distances between places, with not much in between them? Is that a fair statement?
